notes.title: Major Update: Secret Levels, Collectibles and much more!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38411771/b5927e933fad22306a0993f3280883f83afdaced.png[/img]

Put your black clothes on. It is Shinobi time again.

We are very happy to release a major update, with several new features. Thank you very much for all the support, this game wouldn't be possible without you.

So, let me show you what is new!

[hr][/hr]

[h2]All Levels are now available!
[/h2]
Ok, that was unexpected! We're still in early access but decided to release the whole game for you. It might have some minor bugs, but we'd love for you to play the whole experience and give us feedback.

The full main narrative has [b]50 levels in total[/b]. Have fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38411771/d4882f05f425ed5ec7ce36ada69e9729412bb86e.png[/img]


[hr][/hr]
[h2]Secret "Surreal" Levels 
[/h2]

There are 10 secret levels in the game, where you will need to recover artifacts protected by Shogi pieces.

Is it real or just a bad dream? Well, first you need to find them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38411771/4671cd02b66d7e321648529bf8da3f3157ce3a6c.gif[/img]


[hr][/hr]

[h2]Recover all stollen pieces [/h2]

In each secret level you'll find a special artifact. Solve the puzzle to bring them back to the Dojo and learn more about them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38411771/db49a32adfba9c4587ee336f3adb3185f73c5e0d.png[/img]


[hr][/hr]

[h2]More Features
[/h2]

We also added a couple more features like:
[list]
[*] [b]controller support for the gameplay[/b];
[*] New [b]cutscenes[/b];
[*] A "[b]highlight moves[/b]" option.
[/list] 

And some minor things :)

---

We really hope you have a lot of fun with this game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1383050/Chess_Knights_Shinobi/

And let us know of any issue or suggestion you might have. You just need to post a comment on the Community Hub!

Thanks!

notes.title: Minor bug-fixing and an Update from the Devs
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38411771/1897685d77bee7099ecd36e19338f8067e1c132a.jpg[/img]

Hi guys!

First of all thank you so much for supporting this little game! You're awesome!

We've just uploaded a new build with some minor bug-fixing (all achievements are working now!). You can update your game now and have fun :)

Also, we've been working on the next levels and we are pretty excited about it! We are aiming at 50 levels, since the latest puzzles are way more difficult than the ones in the first half of the game.

You can expect a new update this month (September) with some new levels and general improvements to the game!

In the meanwhile, if you still haven't played the first game in the Chess Knights series, I do recommend you play it:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1338980/Chess_Knights_Viking_Lands/

We are also developing the next game in this franchise and all members of our small team are VERY excited about it. There is not much information for now, but you can certainly wishlist it so we can keep you posted:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1404000/Chess_Knights_Eldritch_Hunter/

That's all for today, folks!

Once again thanks a lot for all the support and lovely feedbacks. You're awesome!

Cheers,
Raphael
